appointments.chooseSpecialty.heading: Choose Specialty
appointments.chooseSpecialty.description: Select the medical specialty that best matches your health concern. This helps us match you with the right doctor.
appointments.chooseSpecialty.specialties: Primary care, wellness exams, and general health concerns
Mental health services, therapy coordination, and medication management

appointments.quickGuide.title: Quick Guide
appointments.quickGuide.whatToExpect.bod: After selecting your specialty, you'll choose a doctor, pick a time slot, and confirm your booking. The whole process takes about 2 minutes.
appointments.quickGuide.choosingSpecialt: Not sure which specialty to choose? Select General Practitioner for most health concerns — they can refer you to a specialist if needed.
appointments.quickGuide.insurance.title: Insurance & Costs
appointments.quickGuide.insurance.body: Most appointments are covered by standard insurance plans. You'll see estimated costs during the booking confirmation step.
appointments.pickATime.heading: Pick a Time
appointments.pickATime.description: Select a preferred date and time for your appointment.
appointments.pickATime.calendar.heading: Select Date
appointments.chooseDoctor.heading: Choose a Doctor
appointments.chooseDoctor.description: Select a healthcare provider to continue your booking.
